# FAULTLINE

> Local-first deterministic browser-failure reduction: define an oracle, probe/removes semantic HTML/CSS/JS units, keep changes only when the failure remains, inspect evidence/revisions and export a standalone reproducer.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/dharan1007/faultline
Live product: https://faultline-webmcp-tejs-projects-70bb4568.vercel.app/

## Start here

- README: https://github.com/dharan1007/faultline/blob/main/README.md
- Security policy: https://github.com/dharan1007/faultline/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Technical security boundary: https://github.com/dharan1007/faultline/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md
- Roadmap: https://github.com/dharan1007/faultline/blob/main/ROADMAP.md
- Contributing: https://github.com/dharan1007/faultline/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

## Canonical code path

- `src/runtime.js`
- `src/reducer-engine.js`
- `src/sandbox-policy.js`

Do not describe legacy/experimental domain files as the production reducer unless they are integrated into this path and tests.

## Core facts

- Oracle results: PASS / FAIL / UNRESOLVED.
- Oracles: DOM property, DOM existence, computed style, runtime error.
- Reduction: bounded ddmin over semantic units one axis at a time in the current production runtime.
- Minimality: relative to the tested candidate-unit set; not global shortest-source proof.
- State: local browser persistence, revision snapshots/history, stale-revision guards.
- Execution boundary: sandboxed iframe + restrictive CSP/navigation controls; not OS/VM isolation.
- Agent integration: browser WebMCP when `document.modelContext` is available.
- Runtime npm dependencies: none; Playwright is a development dependency.
- License: MIT.

## Verification

Fast: `npm test && npm run check && npm run build`

Real browser: `npm run test:browser`
